orig: ゼンブ・オブ・ワールド
plotEn:
During a school trip to Tokyo, high school student Yurika Ikezono is determined to make the most of the group's free day. As the leader of her group, she has prepared a detailed itinerary intended to allow them to visit as many of Tokyo's attractions as possible.
However, when the day of free activity arrives, the members of the group unexpectedly go their separate ways. Ikezono finds herself alone beneath the Tokyo Skytree, and initially wonders whether the situation might be the result of a parallel world or reincarnation. She nevertheless decides to continue following the itinerary she had prepared.
While Ikezono visits the city's attractions, the other members pursue their own reasons for coming to Tokyo. Megu Hagawa stalks her crush together with her love rival, Mio Tsujisaka; Shiori Setta, Wakana Tsunomora, Akane Yanatori, and Moe Kadobayashi hunt for limited-edition items; former Tokyo resident Ayano Masutani, originally just intending to take a stroll around the city, ends up struggling to impress her admirer, Miyuki Hanasato, with the help of her old friend Yumeka Mitsutake; and the quiet Chisa Kirii secretly intends to pursue her dream of becoming an idol. As they adventure through the city, their individual pursuits eventually bring them back into contact with one another.
